name: Adriano Santos
action: Adriano sets down the lug wrench, walks to the gate, and says, "I'll come, but only for a short while. I won't play. I'll find a spot where I can feel the drums and don't have to talk much. And I'll leave before it gets too late."
reason: Adriano's initial impulse was to politely decline and return to repairing the drum shell, preserving his routine and avoiding the exposure his hearing loss creates. During reflection, he recalled his own expressed belief that authenticity requires being in the room, not watching from a screen, and recognized that this roda is informal rather than an organized group he distrusts. This reversed his tendency from refusal to acceptance. Still feeling the fear of misreading and speaking too loud at a live event, he adopted a conditional acceptance: he will attend but limit the visit by not playing, positioning himself to listen with minimal conversation, and leaving early. This reflects his lingering motivational conflict—wanting to be present while protecting his independence and avoiding humiliation—and translates into a qualified yes that maintains his control over the situation.
